name: qw2gn5-compact-needs-you-chat
goal: Prove Hub Home shows compact choices with details and typing in dialogs, opens Chief of Staff chat in a bottom-right desktop overlay or a full-screen phone sheet, and documents the list-card rule.

evidence: Updated existing Needs You and Hub message specs with compact chips, detail and confirmation dialogs, desktop CoS widget and phone sheet. Mac and iPhone Tracker inbox uses distinct components.

Compact buttons reuse structured answer controls. Confirmation and Other dialogs render beside the list. All Hub Chief of Staff launch points share one Modal and composer. Desktop and iPhone use their separate TrackerInbox renderer.
